text: They didn't need me on the ninth. I log every round on the Hall 1 panel. They lifted my print off it. Do the same.
style: Operations manager and OT engineer at a grid battery site, mid-fifties. Speak with a consistent North-East English (Teesside) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Firm, low-to-mid pitch; brisk, clipped pace. Conscientious and overworked; defensive at first, then alarmed and determined once he realises the threat is real. Speaking over a phone line from the control room.
